title: Hot reload : Failed to start quarkus, Already a default codec registered for class class java.util.UUID

milestone.title: 1.7.0.CR1
milestone.description:
Core CR1 on July 30th, Core Final on August 6th, Full Platform release (and official announcement) on August 12th

body:
**Describe the bug**
(Describe the problem clearly and concisely.)
Whenever the hot reload is triggered, it fails to restart the app after upgrade to Quarkus 1.6.1
**Expected behavior**
The application is reloaded when the code is updated
